candidate_identification: PROCEDURAL, hash-independent: the package candidate is the commit whose message begins 'FG-PPRC-198 package candidate (final)'. For every commit AFTER it, `git diff --stat <candidate> <commit> -- src tools .foundergate/run-materials package.json package-lock.json` must be EMPTY.

nonrecursive_seal.rule: A commit never contains its own hash or tree.
nonrecursive_seal.stage_A_committed: binds the approved AUTHORITY candidate in reviewed_runtime_*; evidence_commit_* stays the freeze placeholder
nonrecursive_seal.stage_B_not_committed: binds the exact final evidence HEAD/tree, generated outside Git, never committed
nonrecursive_seal.evidence_tail_resolution: resolve procedurally with `git log --oneline <candidate>..HEAD`; this record does not and cannot name the tail's own SHA
